map.估算英文单词转换为摩斯电码后的点划时长。: Convert an English word or character sequence into Morse dot/dash and gap timings to estimate total transmission time.
map.每个符号含点/划及间隔，实际时长约为点划数 × 1.5 个单位: Each symbol includes dot/dash and gaps; actual duration is about dot-dash count x 1.5 units
map.用于理解摩斯电码传输速率。: Used to understand Morse code transmission speed.
map.📚 深度解析：摩斯电码时长: 📚 In Depth: Morse Code Transmission Time

map.教学演示：直观展示点(1 单位)、划(3 单位)与间隔的时长关系。: Teaching demo: visually show the timing relation of dot (1 unit), dash (3 units) and gaps.
map.：为练习设定单字符/单词的计时基准。: to set a timing baseline for single characters/words in practice.
map.SOS(...---...) 在 20 WPM（单位约 60 ms）下约 1.3: SOS (...---...) at 20 WPM (about 60 ms/unit) finishes in about 1.3 seconds (including character/word gaps).
map.PARIS 标准下 1 WPM ≈ 单位时长 1200 ms，20 WPM ≈: Under the PARIS standard, 1 WPM ≈ 1200 ms/unit, 20 WPM ≈ 60 ms/unit.
map.约定点=1、划=3 单位，字符内间隔=1、字符间=3、单词间=7 单位。: Convention: dot = 1, dash = 3 units; intra-character gap = 1, inter-character = 3, inter-word = 7.
map.标准摩斯仅覆盖拉丁字母数字与少数标点，中文需先转拼音/数字。: Standard Morse covers only Latin letters, digits and a few punctuation; Chinese needs pinyin/digits first.
